services.name: Adult & geriatric-focused care
services.caption: Primary care through telemedicine.
services.description: Telemedicine for adults 18 and older, with a particular focus on older adults, chronic conditions, prevention, and maintaining independence. Pediatric care is not offered.
points: Ongoing primary care and medication review
Geriatric care, function, and cognitive assessment when appropriate
services.note: In-person examinations, testing, and referrals may still be needed. Home visits are a future service.

services.name: Weight management
services.caption: Medical weight management.
services.description: Individualized weight-management visits connected to your broader health, with nutrition, activity, sleep, and medical options considered together.
points: Discussion of GLP-1 and other options when clinically appropriate
Follow-up focused on progress, tolerability, and long-term care
services.note: Medication is not guaranteed. Prescriptions, medication costs, and visit pricing will be explained before enrollment.

services.name: Sleep medicine
services.caption: Adult sleep evaluation and follow-up.
services.description: A planned adult sleep-medicine pathway for evaluating sleep concerns and coordinating appropriate testing and follow-up.
points: A conversation about sleep quality and daytime function
Coordination of sleep testing when appropriate
Sleep care connected with primary care and weight management
services.note: Sleep testing and device treatment are not currently offered through this site.

services.name: Transitional care
services.caption: Continuity after a hospital stay.
services.description: Support after a hospital stay, designed to work alongside your existing primary care clinician and specialists—not replace them.
points: Reconcile discharge medications and follow-up plans
Coordinate pending tests, referrals, and home support
Include family or caregivers with patient permission
services.note: Connected glucose meters, scales, blood-pressure devices, and hospital-record integrations are planned. They are not connected to this website today.

services.name: Concierge care
services.caption: A planned membership care model.
services.description: A future membership option for adults seeking more continuity and access to their care team.
points: Defined membership benefits and access arrangements
An emphasis on aging well and independence
Home visits may be considered as the service develops
services.note: Membership pricing, coverage area, hours, and exclusions are not yet established. A membership will not imply unlimited or all-inclusive medical services.

services.name: Hospital medicine
services.caption: Coordination across care settings.
services.description: A future division connecting inpatient expertise with safer transitions and ongoing care at home.
points: Continuity across hospital and outpatient settings
Clinician-reviewed technology to support care teams
services.note: Hospital services and electronic medical record integrations are not available through this site.
